title: extcap: Use ":" as a bookmark separator
description:
Use ":" as a separator instead of "/". Hopefully the former is less
common. Use our discovered extcap interface names to determine if plain
interfaces vs ones with bookmarks.

notes.body: This works for the extcap’s I am aware of.
Interface names in BLF are generated with :: in the middle. Could this cause problems?
Possibly. I updated the change to use a single ":" as a separator, and to split interface + bookmark names only if we have a matching interface name.

+# The following must match extcap.c.

+def bookmark_ifname(ifname, bookmark_name):
+    '''The interface name that we give a bookmark.'''
+    return f'{ifname}:{bookmark_name}'

+def bookmark_listing(ifname, description, bookmark_name):
+    '''How "tshark -D" lists a bookmark.'''

+def pref_ifname(ifname):
+    '''The preference name that we give an interface.'''
+    return re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_]', '_', ifname).lower()
